scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && tsc -p e2e
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix backend run start:prod
